data.title: Interior Ministry Launches Special Stamp for Year of Artificial Intelligence 2026
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The Ministry of Interior, represented by the General Directorate of Passports and in collaboration with the Saudi Data and AI Authority, has launched a special stamp to commemorate the Year of Artificial Intelligence 2026.
    The initiative highlights the significance of AI in supporting digital transformation and service development, underscoring the use of modern technologies to create innovative, smart solutions that enhance service quality and improve the overall beneficiary experience.
    The stamp will be available to travelers passing through the Kingdom’s international airports until the end of the year.
    -- SPA
15:38 Local Time 12:38 GMT
